market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$99; +41% to $140 settle in 2 months would represent an oil shock larger than 2008 or 2022. Prior 52-week high is $117.63. Requires extreme escalation/supply event. Very low probability tail.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan supply event (full Hormuz closure, regional war).
